# Millet Bakes

> A Chennai bakery that bakes cookies, granola, cakes, and wellness hampers from sprouted millets and country palm jaggery. No maida. No refined white sugar. Orders go to the kitchen on WhatsApp.

Millet Bakes is a small-batch bakery studio in Ayanavaram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600023, founded by master baker Santhiya Karthikeyan. The kitchen replaces industrial white flour and refined sugar with finger millet (ragi), foxtail millet, barnyard millet, and unrefined karupatti (palm jaggery).

## Facts

- Brand: Millet Bakes
- Founder: Santhiya Karthikeyan (BNI Chennai; clean-eating educator)
- Studio: Ayanavaram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600023, India
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–7:30 PM IST
- Daily dispatch: fresh batches leave the oven around 4:00 PM
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 63831 00431
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/millet_bakes
- Pickup: by prior slot; self-pickup also offered from the Kodambakkam studio
- Delivery: same-day or next-day inside Chennai; 48–72 hour air courier to most Indian metros
- Positioning: zero maida, zero refined sugar, FSSAI certified craft bakery

## Products

- Foxtail Millet Cookies — ₹400 — 250g
- Oats and Raisin Cookies — ₹400 — 250g
- Millet Granola — ₹850 — 500g
- Wheat Brownie — ₹550 — 250g
- Protein & Fibre-Rich Wheat Chocolate Cake — ₹1000 — 500g

## Services

- WhatsApp bakery orders for homes across Chennai and India
- Corporate wellness hampers with optional branding
- Hands-on millet baking workshops for teams (about 12 to 60+ people), Chennai and pan-India
